goal.objective: Convert completed formalism/manifold reconciliation evidence into deterministic owner-scoped implementation work manifests without mutating owner repositories or creating authority.
success_predicates: Reconciliation receipt is present and COMPLETED
Each admitted delta resolves to exactly one canonical repository owner
Each admitted delta has bounded proposed paths and no active scope collision
No owner repository mutation or credential authority is created
failure_predicates: Incomplete reconciliation is treated as sufficient
Ambiguous or missing owner is silently admitted
Coordinator mutates AE or StegCore source

task.derivation_reason: The evidence-only orchestration requires a separate authority-preserving bridge before any owner repository may receive source-mutation work.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat after reconciliation receipt changes and while owner manifests are unresolved

completion.next_authorized_action: After reconciliation completes, partition deltas by canonical owner, block collisions/ambiguity, and emit owner work manifests for separately authorized repository mutation workers.
terminal_when: All current deltas are either admitted to exactly one owner manifest, blocked by an active collision, or REVIEW_REQUIRED for owner ambiguity
